scientific_integrity: Complete depth-105 exact labeled enumeration with independently implemented small-instance tests and direct checking of all maximal representatives. The previously published abelian-cube-free bound 180 is not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite result for ordinary weighted alphabet {0,1,2} and additive cubes only; no claim about other weight assignments, larger alphabets, or infinite words. Priority remains subject to unindexed-literature risk.
title: Exact maximum length and extremizers of ternary rich additive-cube-free words
